summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd, an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed a 6-K reporting the November 4, 2026 issuance to one institutional holder of a $1.9 million convertible promissory note for $1.71 million cash (90% of principal), plus a warrant for up to 8,030,432 ordinary shares at $0.2366, the prior-day close. The note pays 4% interest (14% default), converts at the lower of $0.2366 or 88% of the 20-day VWAP, floored at $0.04732, with a 4.99% blocker, under a previously reported $100 million SPA with $85.5 million unused. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
